description_en: Enables log delivery for a flow log
kebab_example: aliyun expressconnectrouter activate-flow-log --ecr-id ecr-mezk2idmsd0vx20000 --flow-log-id ecr-flog-m5evbtbpt0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ActivateFlowLog

parameters.help_en: The Express Connect Router (ECR) instance ID
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values:
true: Sends a check request without modifying EPS resources.
false (default): Sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value from your client to ensure that different requests have unique ClientToken values. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The flow log instance ID.
The flow log must be in the DEACTIVATE state. After you invoke DeactivateFlowLog, the flow log enters the DEACTIVATING transitional state. Use polling by invoking DescribeFlowLogs and wait until the status changes to DEACTIVATE before invoking this operation
parameters.help_zh:
流日志实例ID。
FlowLog 必须处于 DEACTIVATE 状态。调用 DeactivateFlowLog 后 FlowLog 先进入 DEACTIVATING 过渡态，需通过 DescribeFlowLogs 轮询等待状态变为 DEACTIVATE 后再调用本接口
parameters.name: flow_log_id

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate failure. For more information about error causes, see error codes
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为200表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message, which is used to replace the `%s` placeholder in the ErrMessage error message.

If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, the request parameter DtsJobId is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则表示所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

Message.description_en: The information returned for the operation

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

True: The call was successful.
False: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：

True：成功。
False：失败
